svg.aria-label: What this step means, what it does not mean, and what comes next, as the journey page states them: three things established with a test that can fail; the limits stated plainly; the next edition's list in order and the question of size; the conviction underneath, that a model's world is relative; and what it would imply if it holds, none of it delivered by this edition

svg.text: What this step means, what it does not mean, and what comes next, in order

quantum-cortex, original figure for the journey page, in the page's words at the first edition, with one sentence of its note of 2026-11-05. The three things established each have a test that can fail.
three things established, each with a test that can fail

g.text: the organ exists and holds what the weights should not
cut the journal and the episodes vanish while the skills stay,
on each of its seeds, in a new process, from the disk alone
the model retrieves and reads, not learning to judge from bytes
at its size it retrieves the right episode and reads it, and does
not learn from the bytes alone to judge whether what it read
answers the question; the limit stated with its size attached,
its attribution measured three ways
the system holds the frozen thresholds
the model deciding and the organ answering, on independent
seeds, once the organ's own judgment is given to the model as a
number and the organ is allowed to veto what it cannot back
to that, the edition adds: under attack, two registers kept apart
what the code does by construction, and what has been measured:
a reader holding another domain's key obtains nothing from the
organ and no claim from the system; on its layer of numbers the
organ reconstructs at a measured defect what it derives

svg.text: What this step does not mean
the limits, declared rather than hidden

g.text: not a product, not a model anyone should deploy,
not a claim of general capability
the model is small; the facts it stores are synthetic and
leakage proof by design; one of the three components of
continuity is measured, two are specified and not built;
the recurrent hybrids are negative at this size; the external
benchmark on open models has one execution and no
agreement yet; the journal's integrity covers its content but
not yet its sequence, a flaw the edition declares rather than hides
not a proof of the two systems thesis
a cortex that does not rebuild what its hippocampus already
holds: this is the first setting in which that thesis can fail
on a table, at a scale one person can afford, and it has not
failed there yet
and of the five weeks after the landing (added 2026-11-05)
nothing of that work holds at a larger size or on natural text,
and the record says so where it says anything

svg.text: a list, not a promise; each item faces a residual the record measured

g.text: the index's buckets, where the remaining retrieval misses live
a wider negative control, the veto's margin measured thin once
the write side separation of near duplicates, its threshold set
on the organ's marks
the detectors as code: a refusal written to the journal with its
cause, a status carried by the answer, a two arm suite
the consolidation arms of the recurrent base
a reader with a local convolution
the agreement of the external arm on one hardware, then larger
open models
the withdrawal of an evicted address from the memory
the same probe under reads, where the salience line gains its
second term
then the question of size
does the reader's selectivity to the entity emerge at a larger
size? a larger run than a free tier allows, in the European high
performance computing environment, declared before it is measured

svg.text: The conviction underneath, stated as a conviction and not a result: a model's world is relative, not absolute
carried over from the author's work on the observer in thermodynamics, named so that a reader knows where the design comes from
what a model knows is known from somewhere, in a context, at a time, by an observer with a frame; a model trained on a corpus holds an environment that pretends to be absolute.
The organ is that conviction made into a component: it stores the where and the when at the write, because the origin of a record cannot be derived later; it is sealed per scope,
one journal per world, so that no answer crosses into a world it was not written in; its answers are citations of a record at a time rather than reconstructions from an average.
None of this is measured as a thesis about relativity; what is measured is the organ.
What it implies, if it holds: none of it delivered by this edition, each made testable by it
for practitioners, a measurement to run on one's own model, with frozen thresholds and a negative control, that answers whether the model holds an episode
or reconstructs it, and an organ that composes with a model of any size in three ways; for the field, a small, public, falsifiable setting for the separation of
skills and episodes; for users, eventually, a memory sealed per subject, that stays on the machine and can be shown to be a memory rather than a prompt

the limits

the conviction
what it would imply
